'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sokol LS Restore Freedom''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Light.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-restorefreedomtothegalaxy-pre.gif|label=Restore Freedom To The Galaxy}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
